summary: ACCEPT at 796f251e. Delta from the reviewed head be6ee40f is tests/integration/README.md ONLY, 7 lines, and it is exactly the required scope paragraph - it names target_refused, target_mirror_symbols, target_matched_orders and identity's order_rows as UNEXERCISED, states that the seed has no broker_order_events and no broker_orders, and states the CONSEQUENCE that removing their window predicates can still leave the suite green. No source or test change; the harness itself is unchanged from the head I verified. Carried forward: the project's first SQL-executed-against-a-real-database test, every scope item verified BY EXECUTION against a real PostgreSQL 16.4 built from portable binaries when Docker was unavailable. S1 - the tests load both modules from their real paths and read module.SQL, no copy and no rewrite on the main path; leak SQL is injected only through an explicit override and _replace_once asserts the anchor is SINGULAR so a source edit cannot silently no-op a mutation. S2 - a literal 'assert live != empty' on top of the per-leg assertions, leg selection is plain arithmetic not derived from the thing under test, and both legs use IDENTICAL seed rows so only the window differs; patching execute() to ignore case.window turns both differential tests RED. S4 - no skip/skipif/xfail/importorskip anywhere, verified four ways (DSN unset, dead port, sqlite DSN, psql off PATH), zero skips and exit 1 in all four, and no env var or marker can turn the DB tests off. CI wiring sound and I confirmed both check runs sit on the exact head, not a base or merge commit. ⭐⭐ THE RESULT: the three known #828 leaks die AND three NOVEL spellings die - a tautological predicate on target_buy_legs, the same on target_exit_episodes, and an unbounded union inserted EARLIER in rows - each killed by a row-count assertion at RUNTIME rather than a string anchor, so the six-round 'fix the named leak, a variation survives' cycle is broken for these CTEs. FOLLOW-UPS, none blocking: seed broker_order_events so the refused_exits NUMERATOR is windowed (the #828 harm was the denominator and that half IS guarded); seed broker_orders so identity's order_rows, the half carrying the actual acceptance signal, is proven; add BOUNDARY rows at exactly since_at and exactly until_at since '<' to '<=' still survives on both modules; _d6_refusal_observation discards the SQL's real CONTROL_* rows and substitutes fabricated ones so a break in the base_* control CTEs stays green; and pass encoding='utf-8' to the psql subprocess for Windows checkouts. REUSABILITY: 121 shared lines, ~61 for the second customer, nothing special-cases D6; two remaining scripts fit with zero harness change, field_acceptance needs an sql_attr or alias because it has no module-level SQL, and _RESET_TABLES is a shared mutable list. NOTE: the harness rebuilds the psql command rather than calling module.query_database, so the module's own invocation shape stays pinned by the existing unit tests.
